for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  echo "attempt $i";
  D=.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py \
  DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug" \
  DRIVE_TARGET=linux \
